22017.note: Original shop of a family Puerto Rican bakery-restaurant that has grown to about a dozen Central Florida locations.
22017.fn: The bakery says the family business began in 2005 at this Lake Underhill location, its original.

22359.note: Orlando's long-running family oyster bar, now run by the founders' oldest son, where oysters are shucked to order along an 80-foot concrete bar.
22359.fn: The family's history page says Lee & Rick's opened in 1950 as a nine-stool oyster bar, with the founders living in the back of the building; it describes growth to today's 80-foot shucking bar and mentions no move.
